Main-main.choose-text: Building a home is definitely not an easy decision. Why should you settle for anything less than perfection? Not with us. If you can't find a solution that suits you among the completed projects, check out the design corner, where we have highlighted the most beautiful houses that have stood out from the world. Find the right one for you and we will help you build it.

Hero.text: The ultimate solution that turns your house into a sleek, efficient energy generator. Save on bills, earn through BIPV incentives, and increase your home's value—all with a stylish, seamless design. Power your future while making money and helping the planet.

first-project.name: Summer house with a loft 35 m²
first-project.text: This modern summer house with a loft will not leave anyone indifferent, in addition it will give the owners of the house a feeling of spaciousness and comfort. Floor-to-ceiling windows provided in the project ensure the large amount of natural light coming through them.

second-project.name: Residential house 72 m²
second-project.text: One of our residential houses – simple, nevertheless esthetically attractive and modern. Light Scandinavian design with excellent house layout : 2 isolated bedrooms, loft floor, fully equipped bathroom and commodious living room.

third-project.name: Residential house 120 m²
third-project.text: Gorgeous residential house with 3 bedrooms, office, spacious living room which is combined with kitchen and fully equipped bathroom. The project is very attractive because the layout is design to be practical and the house is suitable for families with children!

fourth-project.name: Residential house 76 m²
fourth-project.text: This modern and functional 76 m2 house is the ideal choice for a family of 3-4 people. The 3 bedrooms will provide comfort and privacy for all family members. The modern studio living room, combined with the kitchen, will be perfect for relaxing moments together. The large windows not only give it a stylish look, but also bring abundant daylight into the room, making it visually more spacious and brighter. This will be a great choice for those looking for a modern, compact and functional place to call home.

fifth-project.name: Snow House 138 m²
fifth-project.text: The Snow House is a compact, light-filled two-story home that combines smart space planning, a cozy atmosphere, and flexible options.

sixth-project.name: Gerda House 184-241 m²
sixth-project.text: Gerda's house is suitable for families who value practical space layout and want a spacious and bright home.

seventh-project.name: Miia House 115 m²
seventh-project.text: Miia is a cozy two-story house with a Nordic design that fits perfectly in both the city and the middle of nature.

Ehitusinfo.text: Here you’ll find detailed information on how we turn your idea into a final solution.
Ehitusinfo.first-step-text: Custom layouts engineered for transport and seamless site assembly.
Ehitusinfo.second-step-text: Manufacturing in a controlled environment: precision, quality, and speed.
Ehitusinfo.third-step-text: Fast on-site assembly and professional solar system activation.

features.text1: Each panel is integrated into the roof tile, so from a distance your roof looks just as clean and elegant as a traditional roof.
features.text2: The modules generate electricity even in diffuse light and cloudy weather, not only in direct sunlight.
features.text3: The impact- and wind-resistant roofing withstands heavy snow loads, strong winds, and harsh winters.
features.text4: The roof and solar modules are covered by a single warranty, so you don't have to deal with separate systems.

steps.text1: We inspect your property, measure the roof's angle and orientation, and estimate its energy production potential.
steps.text2: We create a customized layout because every roof has its own shape, orientation, and shading conditions.
steps.text3: Our certified installation team integrates the solar roof during the regular roofing process without mounting separate panels.
steps.text4: The system is connected to the grid and configured, allowing your roof to start producing electricity immediately.
